rules.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Declaration - Updated
rules.description: Every retail package must declare the Retail Sale Price in the form 'MRP ₹ xx.xx' or 'MRP Rs. xx.xx (inclusive of all taxes)'.

rules.title: Prohibition of Dual Pricing & Altering MRP
rules.description: Prohibits declaring or affixing multiple MRPs on identical packages, or selling at a price higher than the declared retail price without statutory compounding.
rules.section_penalty: Section 36(1) & Section 39 — Compounding under Section 53 or prosecution before Magistrate.

rules.title: Net Quantity in Standard SI Units
rules.description: Mandates net weight/volume in standard SI metric symbols ('g', 'kg', 'ml', 'l', 'm'). Prohibits non-standard notations such as 'gm', 'gms', 'kgs', 'ltr'.
rules.section_penalty: Section 36(2) — Error in net quantity: 1st Offence: ₹10,000–₹50,000; Subsequent: up to ₹1,00,000 and/or 1 yr imprisonment.

rules.title: Month & Year of Manufacture / Packing
rules.description: Requires the month and year in which the commodity is manufactured, packed, or imported (e.g. 'MFD: 10/2024' or 'PKD: 08/2026') to be clearly declared.
rules.section_penalty: Section 36(1) — 1st Offence: up to ₹25,000; 2nd: up to ₹50,000.

rules.title: Name & Address of Manufacturer / Packer
rules.description: Requires complete name and address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer on the principal display panel.
rules.section_penalty: Section 36(1) — Fine up to ₹25,000 for initial non-compliance.

rules.title: Consumer Grievance Care Contact Details
rules.description: Mandates name, address, telephone number, and email address of the person or office to contact for consumer grievances.

rules.title: Statutory Bulk & Institutional Exemption
rules.description: Exempts packages containing quantity > 25 kg/L (cement/fertilizer > 50kg) or packages meant for industrial or institutional consumers directly.
rules.section_penalty: Exemption waiver applied under Section 18 / Rule 3.

rules.title: Small Package Net Quantity Exemption (<= 10g/ml)
rules.description: Exempts packages of 10g/10ml or less from standard retail declaration requirements, strictly EXCLUDING tobacco and tobacco products.

amendments.summary: Reiterated strict penalty under Section 36(2) for use of deprecated non-metric units ('gms', 'kilo', 'ltrs') on packaged commodities.
